instances.text: Recent advances in large language models have enabled a new generation of log parsers that achieve state-of-the-art accuracy through in-context learning and semantic understanding.
instances.source_text: Recent advances in large language models have enabled a new generation of log parsers that achieve state-of-the-art accuracy through in-context learning and semantic understanding [cite].

instances.text: We identified a fundamental security vulnerability in online LLM log parsers that use self-generated in-context learning.
instances.source_text: Our contributions are: • We identify a fundamental security vulnerability in online LLM log parsers that use selfgenerated ICL: the monotonically growing demo pool creates a persistent attack surface. • We design an over-generalization attack strategy that exploits this vulnerability through two damage channels: ICL contamination and trie poisoning. • We demonstrate that injecting only 60 log entries (3% of stream) causes severe, persistent degradation: 40.33pp FTA drop on BGL and 13.33pp on Thunderbird, with damage persisting 900+ logs after injection ends. • We analyze the attack mechanism through ablation studies, revealing that trie poisoning dominates over demo-pool accumulation as the primary persistence pathway.

instances.text: Our experiments demonstrate that injecting only 60 crafted log entries (3% of stream) causes severe degradation—40.33pp FTA drop on BGL and 13.33pp on Thunderbird—that persists 900+ logs after injection ends.
instances.source_text: Our contributions are: • We identify a fundamental security vulnerability in online LLM log parsers that use selfgenerated ICL: the monotonically growing demo pool creates a persistent attack surface. • We design an over-generalization attack strategy that exploits this vulnerability through two damage channels: ICL contamination and trie poisoning. • We demonstrate that injecting only 60 log entries (3% of stream) causes severe, persistent degradation: 40.33pp FTA drop on BGL and 13.33pp on Thunderbird, with damage persisting 900+ logs after injection ends. • We analyze the attack mechanism through ablation studies, revealing that trie poisoning dominates over demo-pool accumulation as the primary persistence pathway.

instances.text: Ablation studies reveal that trie poisoning dominates over ICL contamination as the primary damage mechanism.
instances.source_text: Ablation studies reveal that trie poisoning—where over-generalized templates silently absorb future logs—dominates over ICL contamination as the primary damage mechanism.
